WITH per_account AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        a.account_id,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3, a.account_id
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_account_amount,
        AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM per_account
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    region,
    avg_account_amount,
    avg_account_balance,
    avg_account_amount / NULLIF(AVG(avg_account_amount) OVER (), 0) AS amount_ratio
FROM region_averages
WHERE AVG(avg_account_amount) OVER () IS NOT NULL
